name: log05

retrieved.name: Watchdog: one server tick took too long
retrieved.cause: One server tick ran for 60 seconds or more (or start-up ran past the limit), so the watchdog shut the server down on purpose. Common causes: heavy world generation or /locate, huge saves, lag machines, too many entities, a slow host.
retrieved.fix: Check what the "Server thread" was doing in the report and fix that; set max-tick-time=-1 in server.properties only while testing.
